tagline: 理光便携相机，1998 年发布
description: 理光于1998年推出的便携相机。配备GR Lens 28mm f/2.8 (7 elements, 4 groups) multi-coating aspherical glass lenses.。快门速度Programed mode Approx 2 to 1/500 second.。感光度ISO25 to ISO3200 (DX) ISO 100 for non-DX.。Passive type multi-autofocus (with focus lock, automatic auxiliary AF light under low lighting, distance measuring range: 0.35m - infinity, Single AF mode, Fixed focus mode.。

specs.镜头: GR Lens 28mm f/2.8 (7 elements, 4 groups) multi-coating aspherical glass lenses.
specs.对焦: Passive type multi-autofocus (with focus lock, automatic auxiliary AF light under low lighting, distance measuring range: 0.35m - infinity, Single AF mode, Fixed focus mode.
specs.光圈: Approx. 2 to 1/250 second, 1/500 (at f/16), Time Mode.
specs.取景器: Reverse Galilean type with LCD bright frame, in-finder illumination under low lighting.
specs.感光度: ISO25 to ISO3200 (DX) ISO 100 for non-DX.
specs.英文简介: The Ricoh GR1s is a high end 35mm compact camera introduced in 1998, noteable for its excellent 28mm lens quality.
